column1: # Coverage ledger for tests/XeRsaTests.cpp (GoogleTest migration; see tests/scripts/CoverageLedger.cmake).
# rows: 6 automatic, 0 hand. Port commits change statuses and never delete a row; rows with status new are not counted.

column5: ported;note:seed 1 and 400 rounds kept; the one require (remainder < divisor && quotient * divisor + remainder == dividend) becomes two ASSERTs inside the loop under SCOPED_TRACE(round), so the first failing round still ends the case as the old early return did

ported;note:the && chain is one EXPECT per fact; the digit write-back compares the optional result with std::optional<Bytes>{digits}; BigUint has no printer, so its comparisons are EXPECT_TRUE(a == b)

ported;note:the key parse and the first signing stay ASSERTs (early returns before); the unsigned-SD check, which the later facts do not depend on, is an EXPECT so it no longer hides them; size and stated length are two EXPECT_EQ; the three refusals are EXPECT_ERROR with the old codes; deterministic signing goes through EXPECT_BYTES_EQ
ported;note:the refusals check has_value only, as before (no error code added)
